sources.name: RRSI
sources.verified: Primary paper/HTML and repository documentation reviewed
sources.lesson: Regularize harness proposals and selection rather than optimizing a repeatedly exposed task set without controls.
sources.limits: Author experiments are not Axon evidence; adopted gates add independent authority and explicit sequential-testing policy.

sources.name: Contrastive Language Models (CLM)
sources.verified: Repository/model card and pinned embedder source inspected
sources.lesson: Independent state/action encodings enable reusable action vectors and conditional candidate ranking.
sources.limits: Not generative, not automatically calibrated or universally optimal; upstream max_tokens truncation and shared text cache require an Axon adapter.

sources.name: Jev / RLCD
sources.verified: Primary research explanation plus retained v0.19/v0.20 references
sources.lesson: Typed probabilistic micro-decisions deserve a specialized backend rather than long generated explanations.
sources.limits: Compatible API shape does not establish calibration, training method or correct use on a new domain.

sources.name: CheckEval
sources.lesson: Decompose evaluation into frozen, traceable checklist questions.
sources.limits: Text-evaluation reliability does not certify code correctness; Axon retains deterministic checks and an explicit unknown evidence state.

sources.name: TinyRouter / TRINITY / vLLM Semantic Router
sources.revision: TRINITY arXiv v2; other live documentation unpinned
sources.verified: Primary research and official routing documentation reviewed
sources.lesson: Separate policy eligibility, learned model/role selection and runtime dispatch.
sources.limits: Treat named systems as alternatives, not required combined dependencies or permission authorities; Axon workload benefits remain unmeasured.

sources.name: CliffCompaction
sources.verified: Repository behavior and proxy workflow reviewed
sources.lesson: Construct bounded context from original history; avoid recursively compacting compactions.
sources.limits: Upstream tool/image-dropping heuristics, prefix assumptions and environment-installation commands are not automatically safe for Axon.

sources.name: TypeLLM/pijev (Permutation Invariant Jev)
sources.verified: README and exact default-branch commit inspected
sources.lesson: Label-aligned averaging across declared option permutations can reduce order sensitivity.
sources.limits: Convex-loss averaging is relative to the average included predictions, not perfect calibration, the best member, or exact invariance for finite sampling.

sources.name: RLM-Cascade
sources.lesson: Use bounded draft/verify/skip response paths and bypass schema-critical tool-selection where appropriate.
sources.limits: Small author workloads do not imply universal savings or target-distribution equivalence; Axon initially permits isolated proposals only.

sources.name: Cursor harness token efficiency (supporting economics reference)
sources.lesson: Evaluate cache-aware, price-weighted costs over complete tasks rather than one request.
sources.limits: Supporting reference only, not a ninth required research runtime.

unavailable.claim: No independent inspection of Notion text; do not infer missing material from README.
